problem_text: Variables xin1 and yin1 each range over integers 0 through 4. Require xin1 < yin1. How many ordered assignments are possible?
Variables xin2 and yin2 each range over integers 0 through 5. Require xin2 < yin2. How many ordered assignments are possible?

Variables xmi1, ymi1, zmi1 each range over integers 0 through 5. All variables are distinct. Their sum is exactly 6. How many assignments satisfy all conditions?
Variables xmi2, ymi2, zmi2 each range over integers 0 through 6. All variables are distinct. Their sum is exactly 7. How many assignments satisfy all conditions?
Variables xmi3, ymi3, zmi3 each range over integers 0 through 5. All variables are distinct. Their sum is exactly 8. How many assignments satisfy all conditions?
Variables xmi4, ymi4, zmi4 each range over integers 0 through 6. All variables are distinct. Their sum is exactly 6. How many assignments satisfy all conditions?
